contentPattern.structure: eyebrow + heading + paragraph on the left, media card (looping video / image) on the right, overlaid statistics bar (3 figure/label pairs) + footnote link

suitableFor: light top-of-page heroes laid out as text-beside-media
brand banners that overlay a small statistics / KPI strip on a media card
Our Impact / mission-style intros pairing a headline with headline figures on a light background
notSuitableFor: dark full-bleed hero banners with an overlaid stats strip (use hero-stats)
light heroes with a single centered white content card and no stats (use hero-video)
simple heroes without a media card or stats
